accuracyFlags: Says total fire bans 'prohibit all open flame regardless of rating' and in the next breath that gas appliances are generally permitted: internally contradictory (solid-fuel fires banned, gas conditional).
Treats 'total fire ban' as a national mechanism; Queensland uses local fire bans under QFES rather than statewide total fire bans and WA/SA/Tas have their own names; add per-state source links.
'Check before you go' lists only the Bureau of Meteorology; no state fire authority links (RFS, CFA, QFES, DFES, CFS, TFS) for rules the page says to check.
'Complete fire bans override normal campground permission' consistent, but penalty claims ('imprisonment') have no source.
